name: LAPTRUST Imara I-REIT
source: Audited financial statements for the year ended 31 December 2025, LAPTRUST Imara I-REIT
note: Kenyan shillings. Revenue is rental and related income plus other income from operations, both printed. Operating expenses are property, fund operating and utility expenses, all printed, and Revenue less them equals the printed operating profit. The REIT was ungeared so there is no finance line and no tax. Profit equals the printed profit before fair value changes, which is the amount carried into retained earnings; the investment property revaluation of 540,098,497 is taken to the fair value reserve and is not a profit row.
